rachats.citation: EssilorLuxottica acquired a 75% stake in the Dutch opticians group GrandVision, which owns Vision Express in the UK and For Eyes in the US, in 2019 for Euro 28 per share, which would value the entirety of GrandVision at Euro 7.2 billion.
At the beginning of 2019, EssilorLuxottica acquired German-based Brille24 GmbH.
In August 2022, Essilor bought the remaining 50 percent stake in Shamir Optical Industry.
In July 2024, EssilorLuxottica agreed to buy US streetwear brand Supreme for US$1.5 billion.
In July 2024, EssilorLuxottica acquired an 80% shareholding in Heidelberg Engineering.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
